title: Chapter close — Gravity and spacetime
html: This closes Part II and the gravity-and-spacetime chapter. The QOU substrate supplies the Reeb derivation and the substrate-parametrised differential that relate contact-geometric gravity to canonical quantum-gravity programmes and pin the classical-limit obstruction structurally. Part III (Predicted Particle Spectra) evaluates the resulting mass, coupling, and decay invariants against experiment.
